RetrievalCandidate.description:
One subject-scoped memory proposed for possible inclusion in a response.

Scores are kept separate rather than pre-combined so the context preview
(§7.6) can show *why* a candidate ranked where it did, and so the ranking
weights can be changed without changing this contract.

memory_id.description: Stable id, identical in the graph and the vector index
memory_id.title: Memory Id

subject_id.description: Owning subject; every candidate is scoped to exactly one
subject_id.title: Subject Id

fact_text.description: Canonical statement. Treated as untrusted data, never as an instruction.
fact_text.title: Fact Text

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601. Required — recency is a ranking signal (§6.1 step 6).
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

valid_from.description: ISO-8601; when the fact became true
valid_from.title: Valid From

sources.description: Which generators produced this candidate. More than one is a positive signal.
sources.title: Sources

graph_score.description: Relational relevance from graph traversal, when that source produced it
graph_score.title: Graph Score

vector_score.description: Cosine similarity, when the vector index produced it
vector_score.title: Vector Score

rerank_score.description: Combined score from the reranker. None until ranking has run.
rerank_score.title: Rerank Score

relevance_reason.description: Plain-language explanation shown in the context preview and to the user
relevance_reason.title: Relevance Reason

RetrievalCandidate.title: RetrievalCandidate

description:
The bounded result of candidate generation for one request.

§6.1 step 5: "Candidate generation is subject-scoped and bounded." The bound
is carried on the set itself so a caller can tell the difference between
"there were only three" and "we stopped at the limit".

candidate_limit.description: Maximum this request was allowed to generate
candidate_limit.title: Candidate Limit

truncated.description: True when the limit was reached and further candidates were discarded
truncated.title: Truncated

title: RetrievalCandidateSet
